today_summary: GCM26 prints $3,515.5 on the 23 Nov 11:00 BKK scrape — down $169.9 (-4.61%) from Friday's $3,685.4 and now $184.5 below the $3,700 put wall (5,928 contracts) that floored the tape for three straight sessions. ATM IV repriced to 38.0% from 24.49% (+13.51pp), putting the 1σ daily move at $84.2 (2.39%), so the $3,500 shelf — 3,525 OI and 421 lots traded, the only live strike under spot — sits inside a single session's range. Net GEX within $200 of spot is -230.6 and the cumulative profile never crosses zero anywhere in the ±25% window: every near-spot strike is dealer-short gamma, so hedging amplifies moves in both directions. Headline max pain $5,500 is noise — 48.2% of the 305,539 call OI sits at $5,000 and above, and the ±$400 local pain minimum pins to the window's upper edge at $3,915.
five_day_thesis: The $3,700 put wall broke, and that is the week's structural event: it held as the floor on 18–20 Nov with spot $42–$164 above it, and now sits $184.5 overhead — the chain's largest put shelf has flipped from support into the level bulls must reclaim. Spot has lost $337.6 (-8.76%) across the five sessions and the slide is accelerating, with half of the damage ($169.9) landing in the last session alone. The vol regime did not merely stress, it broke: ATM IV ran 24.89% → 38.0% (+13.11pp) while total put OI drained 117,986 → 91,398 (-22.5%), so holders monetized protection into the drop instead of rolling it down — there is no fresh hedging demand building a floor underneath. Dealer posture deepened in lockstep: window net GEX slid -255.3 → -345.6, the most negative of the five sessions, and the heaviest short-gamma pockets ($3,500 at -39.4, $3,700 at -62.6) now sit at and just above spot. The call wall has been frozen at $5,500 / 16,556 contracts for all five sessions — none of this selling touched the upside shelf, so the entire week's change is a downside-structure story.
what_changed: Put wall $3,700 (5,928 contracts) breached — spot now $184.5 below the level that held three consecutive sessions.
ATM IV 24.49% → 38.0% (+13.51pp in one session) — 1σ daily move widened from $56.9 to $84.2.
Put OI 102,013 → 91,398 (-10,615 on the session, -22.5% over five days) — protection monetized, not rolled lower.
Net GEX (±20% window) -343.3 → -345.6, a fifth straight deepening — no zero-crossing exists in the chain, so no stabilizing regime sits above spot.
P/C OI ratio 0.33 → 0.30, a 5-day low — call OI (305,539) now outweighs put OI (91,398) better than 3:1.
Put-OI vacuum below $3,410 (1,599) — only 798 at $3,300 and 544 at $3,250 until the 2,245-contract shelf at $3,000.
prediction: Bias bearish while spot holds below $3,700. Path of least resistance is a test of the $3,500 shelf (3,525 OI); losing it with ±$200 net GEX at -230.6 opens the thin zone into the $3,450–$3,410 cluster, and beneath that the put-OI vacuum offers almost nothing until $3,000. A reclaim of $3,700 invalidates the thesis — that puts spot back above the broken wall and forces the short-gamma hedging flow to work in reverse.
